heading: 13.3 `FxRate` schema
text:
### 13.3 `FxRate` schema [LUNI.13.3]

The integration contract is **a published schema**, not a service call.
Integrators emit `FxRate` facts; DS rules and `unit fx_pair` declarations
consume them like any other fact. The standard library's is
`units.currency.FxRate` by its own name ([LIMP.13.1]), which is the name an
integrator asserts it by. `FxRate` is `ttl`-scoped at `1_h`, with
slots:

| Slot | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `base_code` | String | ISO 4217 code, e.g. `"USD"` |
| `quote_code` | String | ISO 4217 code, e.g. `"EUR"` |
| `rate_num` | Int | numerator |
| `rate_den` | Int | denominator — rate = `rate_num / rate_den` |
| `rate_dp` | Int | decimal places the rate source reported (display / audit) |
| `asof` | Time | rate observation time |
